h:
此工作流程用于生成超详细的 4k 壁纸大小的图像。在我的 4090 上，它可以在大约 45 秒内生成图像。它尚未在少于 24 GB 的卡上进行过测试，但我很好奇它是否有效（也许用平铺节点替换其他一些 VAE 编码/解码节点并向下调整平铺大小可能会有所帮助）。

编辑：已确认在 11GB 2080Ti 上工作。

o.en:
This workflow is for generating hyper-detailed 4k wallpaper-sized images. On my 4090, it can generate images in about 45 seconds. It hasn't been tested on cards with less than 24 gigs, but I'd be curious if it works (maybe swapping out some of the other VAE encode/decode nodes with tiling ones and adjusting the tile size down may help).

Edit: Confirmed working on an 11GB 2080Ti.
